description: The certified lockstep set: these tool versions were verified TOGETHER. Re-certified 2026-07-28 after the nav-QA anchor work. This is the first set under which a walktest has PASSED anything: three of four category5_baie_dore_001 candidates come back ok=True with 0 of 31 legs failing, 0 stranded anchors and 0 anchors without standing room, against a baseline of four-of-four failing with 9 legs each. The defect was never the navmesh. A marker is where a thing IS; an anchor is where a body has to stand to use it, and the pipeline had never distinguished them -- so sixteen of twenty-one anchors were demanding walkable routes onto cashier counters and into vault blocks. Lot 0.29.0 resolves anchors to their room's floor, searches that storey plane for standing room, and resolves an anchor whose nearest standing room is unreachable to the nearest CONNECTED one -- which for a vault is the floor outside its breach panel. NOT covered by this set: seed_5320 still reports one vault anchor off the main network and is the one candidate of four that fails; whether that is a sealed vault whose door is further than the 6 m search bound or a genuinely broken room is unresolved and needs the geometry, not a bigger radius. WALKTEST_ENFORCED remains False, so walktest findings WARN rather than block, and the existing library has still never been walktested. Portfolio approval still awaits the visual-score art leg.

deli_counter.note: owns the collision contract; agent_contract.json is the source the Lot clearance math derives from

laser_tag.note: pinned from 0.8.0 onward. It reported UNKNOWN until then not because the addon had no version -- plugin.cfg always declared one -- but because the repo had no root VERSION file, which is the only place verify-manifest looks. The two are mirrors and the lasertag lint job fails if they disagree. Cache invalidation still rests on content, not on this line: the Level Factory adapter hashes addons/laser_tag_tool into fingerprint_inputs, so an addon edited without a bump still invalidates.

level_factory.note: 0.14.0 removed the scheduler's resume pre-skip: a re-run dispatches every job and replays findings from the content cache instead of trusting a recorded status. 0.15.0 added the walktest_navqa stage. 0.18.0 splits what used to be one anchor code into three, because a room that did not bake (WALKTEST_ANCHOR_NO_FLOOR), an anchor that connects to nothing (WALKTEST_ANCHOR_ISOLATED) and a marker inside the furniture (WALKTEST_MARKER_BURIED, minor) send a reader to different repos. 0.18.1 makes _finding coerce `location` -- one finding passing a Path killed a whole four-seed run after three seeds had done their walker sims. 0.19.0 adds WALKTEST_ANCHOR_BEHIND_BARRIER, the one place the walktest passes over a substitution and therefore the one that has to say so.

lot.note: cover clearance and lane pinch are derived from the Deli Counter agent contract, not hardcoded. 0.28.0 emits nav-QA anchors on their room's FLOOR (read from the room record, not derived from story x 4) and merges markers that coincide once dropped; the director searches the anchor's own storey plane for standing room, with a band that is asymmetric on purpose -- a body height down, one max_climb plus a voxel up. 0.29.0 resolves an anchor whose nearest standing room is on a component nothing reaches to the nearest CONNECTED one, bounded by the same 6 m, and reports both distances; it also unions clusters on MUTUAL reachability, because arrival is judged within SNAP_MAX of the destination and one directed edge had been enough.

pipeline.note: Phase 4 complete: 100 configs / 36 families / 20 missions / 8 heroes registered, engine-gated; approval awaits visual scores

pixelcoat.note: version lives in pixelcoat/version.py, not a root VERSION file
